$comment: Selected work only — this is a cut, not a repository dump. `tier: "selected"` gets the full editorial treatment; `tier: "also"` gets one line in the index. A project with visibility "private" renders its access note instead of a dead source link.

projects.name: F.F Real Estate
projects.summary: A Karachi property firm had no way to be found in a search result and no way to be contacted from one. Every page now routes to the same two actions — WhatsApp or call — behind a filterable listing the client publishes themselves.
highlights: Embedded Sanity Studio at /studio — the client adds properties and photos with no code and no second login
Filter by purpose, type, location, bedrooms, price and size, with a page per property
JSON-LD, Open Graph and per-page metadata for the business and every listing

projects.name: LeadFlow
projects.summary: Finds small businesses whose web presence is broken or missing, proves the breakage is real, ranks them by need, and produces a call list where every row carries a specific true observation.
highlights: Deduplication tries five signals strongest-first — provider ID, phone, registrable domain, name within 120 m, then name and city. Merging only fills blanks.
Every claimed website is fetched and graded into one of nine outcomes, from none_claimed through parked and thin to ok
Runs itself every morning on GitHub Actions and syncs to Google Sheets without touching human-edited columns
projects.access: Private — it runs my own outreach. Happy to walk the architecture and source on a call.

metrics.note: Karachi returns a single qualified lead because there a missing website usually means not-yet-mapped rather than no website — so absence is never treated as a fact unless something corroborates it.

projects.name: Sales Hub
projects.summary: Pipeline, activity log and lead list in one view, reading and writing a Google Sheet as its database — so the data stays somewhere the owner can still open, sort and fix by hand.
highlights: Google Sheets as the system of record, with the app as a typed interface over it
Pipeline stages, activity history and lead detail without a second place to keep in sync

projects.name: Event Hub
projects.summary: A cross-platform event management app built with two other engineers during the mobile internship — the work behind the Star Performer result.
highlights: 12+ production screens across home, catalog, profile and event creation
Debounced real-time search, Firebase auth and live sync, push via Firebase Cloud Messaging
Built, signed and distributed as an Android APK outside the Play Store

projects.name: Nexora
projects.summary: A concept landing page for a fictional developer platform — built to push scroll-driven motion and WebGL further than a client brief usually allows.

projects.name: Fit Pro Gym
projects.summary: A one-page site for a Karachi gym with no web presence. Hand-written HTML, CSS and JavaScript — no framework, no bundler, nothing to go stale.
